<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/subscription">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Signup" name="Signup information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Cancellation" name="Cancellation request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Communications" name="Subscription communications"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Subscription">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Service" name="Subscription service" processRef="Process_Subscription"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Signup" name="Signup information" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Signup" messageRef="Message_Signup"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Cancellation" name="Cancellation request" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Event_CancellationReceived" messageRef="Message_Cancellation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Communications" name="Subscription communications" sourceRef="Task_SendCommunications" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_Communications"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Subscription" name="Subscription service" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Subscription">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_System" name="System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Signup</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignAccess</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RunBilling</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendCommunications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_CancellationReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Support" name="Support team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessCancellation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AdjustmentsSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyRefund</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyCharge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AdjustmentsJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeactivateSubscription</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SettleBalance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Settled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Signup" name="Customer signs up">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Signup" messageRef="Message_Signup"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateAccount" name="Generate account"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AssignAccess" name="Assign access"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RunBilling" name="Run automated billing cycles during subscription"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendCommunications" name="Send regular updates, product enhancements, and renewal notifications" messageRef="Message_Communications"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CancellationReceived" name="Cancellation request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Cancellation" messageRef="Message_Cancellation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessCancellation" name="Process cancellation request"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdjustmentsSplit" name="Determine applicable account adjustments" default="Flow_NoAdjustment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplyRefund" name="Apply refund"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplyCharge" name="Apply charge"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdjustmentsJoin" name="Complete account adjustments"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeactivateSubscription" name="Deactivate subscription"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SettleBalance" name="Settle final account balance"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Settled" name="Subscription deactivated and final balance settled"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Signup" targetRef="Task_GenerateAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_GenerateAccount" targetRef="Task_AssignAccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_AssignAccess" targetRef="Task_RunBilling"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_RunBilling" targetRef="Task_SendCommunications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_SendCommunications" targetRef="Event_CancellationReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Event_CancellationReceived" targetRef="Task_ProcessCancellation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_ProcessCancellation" targetRef="Gateway_AdjustmentsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refund" sourceRef="Gateway_AdjustmentsSplit" targetRef="Task_ApplyRefund">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>refund applies under subscription terms</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Charge" sourceRef="Gateway_AdjustmentsSplit" targetRef="Task_ApplyCharge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>charge applies under subscription terms</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdjustment" sourceRef="Gateway_AdjustmentsSplit" targetRef="Gateway_AdjustmentsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundToJoin" sourceRef="Task_ApplyRefund" targetRef="Gateway_AdjustmentsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChargeToJoin" sourceRef="Task_ApplyCharge" targetRef="Gateway_AdjustmentsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Gateway_AdjustmentsJoin" targetRef="Task_DeactivateSubscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_DeactivateSubscription" targetRef="Task_SettleBalance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_SettleBalance" targetRef="EndEvent_Settled"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
